svg.text: Deployment -> ReplicaSet -> Pods and the labels that connect them
this is what rollout undo uses
Pods are created and destroyed, never repaired.
Every replacement gets a NEW NAME and a NEW IP.
Which is why nothing should ever address a pod
Labels and selectors are the only glue in Kubernetes
There are no pointers, no IDs, no foreign keys. A ReplicaSet does not hold a list of its pods.
It holds a QUERY: "every pod labelled app=catalog-api". It counts the matches and acts on the difference.
must match the pod template labels
Services in Module 11 use the SAME query
